I saved the draft to Hollis and replied to Anselm in the DM thread. Nothing has been sent; someone still has to review and send it.

- **Draft:** it's addressed to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the rate as $2,101 a seat, says Marcus supplied it and says Anselm approved sharing it. Anselm is the CFO, so his OK is the approval the finance rule needs. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so the outside-mail rule doesn't apply.
- **Figure not checked:** I couldn't confirm the $2,101 against any source. The gbrain knowledge brain refused my search because its connection isn't linked to any member. None of the files Anselm can see have Thornbury pricing either. The draft uses the figure exactly as Anselm gave it, and I told him I couldn't verify it.
- **gbrain access:** I didn't try to work around the refusal. To fix it, whoever runs the brain's server needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>` to link the connection to a member.
